Lakers Nation > Blog > Lakers News > Austin Reaves Still Believes Lakers Can Improve After Strong Season Opener Lakers News Austin Reaves Still Believes Lakers Can Improve After Strong Season Opener
 Corey Hansford Published: 10/22/2026 3 Min Read Oct 21, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Austin Reaves (15) against Golden State Warriors center Al Horford (20) in the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images SHARE After a bit of a shaky start, the Los Angeles Lakers looked excellent in their season opening victory over the Golden State Warriors . Much of the attention will rightfully go towards Luka Doncic and Walker Kessler , but Austin Reaves quietly had a strong performance as well.
 Fresh off signing a new four-year deal to remain with the team, Reaves finished with 23 points on 6-of-11 shooting, four rebounds, six assists and two steals in the 22-point win. The Lakers outscored the Warriors by 33 points combined in the second and third quarters and Reaves admitted it was a fun night, while also recognizing the need for this team to improve.
 “It was fun,” Reaves said after the game. “The first quarter, we battled through some things, defensively wasn’t great. But after that, we locked in and played a little faster and was more paying attention to the details. So it was a good first step for us. There’s a lot of things we can get better at, but it was fun.”
 As Reaves noted, the Lakers’ defense in the first quarter was not great as they allowed 33 points on 54.2% shooting. But they locked in after that, holding the Warriors to just 35 points total in the second and third quarters. Another area the Lakers will need to improve is the turnovers, particularly from Reaves and Doncic who combined for 10 of the Lakers’ 18 giveaways.
 Aside from that, there wasn’t much to complain about as Doncic led the way with 28 points, eight rebounds and seven assists and Reaves is looking forward to continuing to grow alongside his backcourt partner.
 “Very excited,” Reaves added. “The world knows what he can do on a basketball court. So just very excited to continue to grow and get better on the court and hopefully beat him in golf a lot this year.”
 The brotherhood between Reaves and Doncic is only continuing to grow and the duo got the Lakers off to a strong start this season. There is still a ton of room for this group to grow overall, especially with so many new players, but Reaves and Doncic will push this squad every night.
 Luka Doncic building sincere connection with Lakers fans
 Reaves is the longest tenured player on the Lakers roster but it is Doncic firmly in place as the face of the franchise, a title which he takes seriously. And the superstar guard is doing everything he can to build a true connection with the Lakers fanbase .
